gloss: in small increments; bit by bit

definitions.gloss: in small increments; bit by bit; in small steps
definitions.explanation: Describes something done in frequent small amounts or movements rather than in large ones. Often used with に as an adverb. Composed of 小 (small) + 刻み (chopping, increments).

examples.japanese: {小刻|こきざ}みに{震|ふる}えている。
{値段|ねだん}が{小刻|こきざ}みに{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: The price is going up in small increments.

examples.japanese: {小刻|こきざ}みな{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}りながら{長距離|ちょうきょり}を{走|はし}った。
examples.english: I ran a long distance while taking frequent short breaks.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used adverbially as {小刻|こきざ}みに to describe actions done in rapid, small repetitions — trembling, tapping, stepping, or gradual changes. Can also be used as a na-adjective with な: {小刻|こきざ}みな{動|うご}き (small, quick movements).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小刻|こきざ}みに{震|ふる}える (to tremble in small shakes)
- {小刻|こきざ}みに{動|うご}く (to move in quick, small motions)
- {小刻|こきざ}みな{変動|へんどう} (small fluctuations)
- {小刻|こきざ}みに{休憩|きゅうけい}を{取|と}る (to take frequent short breaks)
